# Bulletproof Shrink Wraps LLC

> Mobile shrink wrap company in Spirit Lake, Idaho, owned and run by Chris since 2011. Wraps boats, RVs, vehicles, ATVs, tractors, equipment, homes, sheds and hoop shelters for winter storage or transport, on land or on the water, across North Idaho and the Spokane area.

- Phone: (208) 446-9327 (call or text, open 24 hours)
- Email: bulletproofshrinkwraps@gmail.com
- Address: 182 Rigby Way, Spirit Lake, ID 83869
- Google rating: 5.0 from 17 reviews
- Google Business Profile: https://maps.google.com/?cid=1058579498482986605

## Starting prices (per foot)
- Storage wrap on land: from $24/ft
- Storage wrap on the water: from $26/ft
- Transport wrap: from $32/ft
- Commercial or industrial wrap: from $35/ft
- Jobs over 100 miles round trip add a flat $100 fuel fee

## Areas served
Spirit Lake, Coeur d'Alene, Hayden, Post Falls, Rathdrum, Athol, Sandpoint, Priest River, Spokane and Spokane Valley.
